SIM amélioré · design log · 25 Nov 2026

From a dead end at the first run to a one-click fix on the block

A step-by-step record of the three Claude skills used on Sim's first-use experience (Free plan on sim.ai), from the original product to the improved code in this repo. Each step lists what changed and shows screenshots before and after, with the changes circled in red.

Unofficial test copy, not affiliated with Sim Studio. The original code is kept at the tag sim-original.

Circled in red: what this step changed 1 Numbers match the bullet points of the step Before After Same element, before and after

How the screenshots were made

  • Before: real screenshots of sim.ai taken during the audit (25 Nov 2026, Free plan, dark theme), shown at 800 × 500 px. Some are zoomed in 2× on the notification so its text can be read.
  • After: Sim's real components from this repo (the block card, the notification and the model picker), rendered on their own page with Sim's own compiled stylesheet. The full app couldn't be run locally because it needs Docker and PostgreSQL. So these shots show the components outside the editor, and the text uses the system font instead of Sim's web font.
  • Behaviour that a still image can't show, such as where the cursor goes or keyboard use, is listed without a red box.

00

Starting point: the first run fails, and the way out is a paywall

Starting pointPage: sim.ai workflow editor, Free plan
  • A new workspace's Agent block uses claude-sonnet-5-5. On the Free plan, running it fails because that model only runs on Sim's key for paid plans.
  • The notification cuts the reason to 3 grey lines, and its only button, Fix in Chat, opens a "Paid Plan Required" dialog.
  • The block itself still looks healthy, and there's no API key field on it: the free fix is hidden in Settings.
01

An honest model picker and an error that offers the free fix

/ux-superpowersReport: ux-audit/01-ux-discovery-report.md

Request: Audit on sim.ai first /ux-superpowers, then P1: picker + error

The 8-step discovery (personas, jobs to be done, journey, insights, telemetry) found that a new user's first result never comes on the Free plan. The default model and even the cheapest one are paid-only, and every recovery path opens another paywall. Its top recommendation became improvement 1.

  • 1The error leads with the free fix: it now reads "<model> needs your own API key on the Free plan. Add one in Settings > BYOK, or upgrade to use Sim's key."
  • 2Add API key instead of Fix in Chat: the notification's button opens the API key settings, instead of a chat that is itself a paid feature.
  • 3The picker says which models need a key: models a free workspace can only run with its own key show a "Needs your key" badge, in the list and on the selected model.
  • 4Search replaces the model: clicking the model field selects its text, so typing a search replaces the current model instead of appending to it ("claude-sonnet-5-5nano").
  • The two tests and the docs line that quoted the old wording were updated. Point 4 is a click behaviour, so only its "before" can be shown.
02

A critique of the failure moment, and a badge that doesn't read as "legacy"

/design:design-critiqueCritique: ux-audit/02-design-critique.md

Request: on continue : /design:design-critique puis /interaction-design

The critique looked at the editor at the moment a run fails, and at improvement 1. Its findings set the work for step 3:

  • Critical: the notification cuts the error to 3 lines, the fix is far away in Settings, and the API key field is hidden for models Sim hosts.
  • Moderate: the failed block looks healthy on the canvas, and the notification text fails contrast (about 3.1:1 in the dark theme).
  • 1Blue badge instead of amber: Sim already uses an amber badge for "legacy" blocks, so an amber "Needs your key" read as a warning about the model. The badge is now blue, an information colour.
03

The fix sits next to the failure

/interaction-designSpec: ux-audit/03-interaction-spec.md

Request: on continue : /design:design-critique puis /interaction-design, then ok mets en place ce qui est à modifier

The spec lists every state, timing (each with a reason), motion with a reduced-motion version, error recovery, keyboard and screen-reader behaviour, plus 4 questions left open on purpose. Improvement 2 builds its critical and moderate parts.

  • 1API key field on the block: on the Free plan, the Agent block now shows its API key field for models Sim hosts, so a key can be added right there. A key already on the block keeps the field visible, so it is never silently dropped.
  • 2One-line notification that leads to the field: it reads "Needs your own API key on the Free plan." Its Add API key button opens the block and puts the cursor in the key field, with a short red highlight.
  • 3The failed block shows it failed: it keeps a red outline until the next run, and a red Needs API key status when the missing key caused the failure. Clicking the status opens the key field.
  • 4Readable notification text: the description uses Sim's body text colour instead of the muted grey, so it passes contrast. This applies to every notification in Sim.
  • Not visible in a still image: the highlight is skipped when the computer is set to reduce motion. The status works with the keyboard (Enter or Space). If the block isn't on the open canvas, Add API key opens Settings > BYOK instead. People without edit access see "Edit access required to fix".
  • Point 1 lives in the editor panel, which can't be rendered without the running app, so only its "before" is shown: the model field with no key field under it.
✓

Where it stands now

Code: sim-ameliore/ on fnnysimon/projects
  • Checked: type-check passes for the app and the two packages changed, biome lint passes on every changed file, and 2,763 of Sim's 2,764 existing tests pass in the areas touched. The one failure is a cost-formatting test that expects "2,113 credits" and gets "2 113 credits" on a French-locale computer, in code these changes don't touch.
  • Not yet checked in the running app: running Sim locally needs Docker and PostgreSQL. Docker Desktop is installed, but Windows needs a full restart before it can run.
  • Still to do from the spec: the key field's height animation, a placeholder that names the provider, and keeping the model search text.
